remarks:
PRIVATE WOODED 15-ACRE RETREAT WITH SUNROOM, TRAILS & EXPANSIVE VIEWS

Tucked deep within a private 15-acre woodland, this home offers a rare sense of peace and seclusion. Winding trails weave through the trees, leading to a quiet pond and open spaces perfect for creating gardens or enjoying the outdoors. From the edge of the property, a short walk brings you to approximately 250 acres of state forestry—an expansive natural playground for hiking, snowshoeing, and snowmobiling throughout the seasons.
The home’s sunroom is its most captivating space with two sets of doors open to the outdoors, and an enclosed hot tub makes this room a year-round retreat where nature is always within reach. Just steps away, a three-season screened-in porch with its own fireplace invites you to unwind while taking in the view. This porch opens to a full wrap-around deck, where mornings begin with sunlight filtering through the trees and evenings settle into quiet moonlit skies. The front porch offers an expansive vantage point for sunsets, stargazing, and the kind of big-sky scenery that feels miles away from everything.
Inside, the home is warm and welcoming, offering four bedrooms and two full baths. The dining room is perfectly suited for entertaining, while the large kitchen features cherry cabinetry, ceramic flooring, and a center island that opens directly to the family room. With beamed ceilings, walls of windows, and a fireplace, this space is ideal for gathering with friends and family or simply relaxing at the end of the day. 
For those who need space to work, create, or store equipment, the property includes an attached two-car garage as well as a remarkable 28x40 two-story garage with power and a woodstove. This structure is perfectly suited for a workshop, hobbies, or additional storage. The acreage also offers open areas ideal for horses, giving the property even more versatility.
With its wooded privacy, scenic views, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, this home offers a tranquil lifestyle surrounded by nature. It is a place where mornings begin quietly, evenings end peacefully, and every day feels connected to the land.  Sq ft includes sunroom.
